instantunify.config.title: InstantUnify Configuration
instantunify.config.blacklist.tooltip: Tag names that should not be unified. Regular expressions are supported.
instantunify.config.whitelist.tooltip: Tag names that should be unified. Regular expressions are supported.
instantunify.config.listMode.tooltip: How the whitelist and the blacklist are combined.
instantunify.config.preferredMods.toolti: The first mod in this list that provides a material wins. Mods that are not listed are treated equally.
instantunify.config.blacklistMods.toolti: Items of these mods are never replaced and are never used as a replacement.
instantunify.config.exemptMods.tooltip: Items of these mods are never replaced, but other mods items may still turn into them.
instantunify.config.sameModNoUnify.toolt: Whether items of one mod are never unified with each other. On by default: the variants a mod ships often only make sense next to each other.
instantunify.config.alternatives.tooltip: One line per group, names separated by commas. Tags of the same group are treated as the same material.
instantunify.config.drop.tooltip: Unify items when they drop on the ground.
instantunify.config.death.tooltip: Unify the drops of dying entities.
instantunify.config.second.tooltip: Scan and unify the player inventory once per second.
instantunify.config.change.tooltip: Unify inventory slots as soon as they change.
instantunify.config.gui.tooltip: Unify the contents of a container when it is opened. This writes into chests and machines.
instantunify.config.harvest.tooltip: Unify generated loot, which covers block drops, mob drops, chests and fishing.
instantunify.config.indexCache.tooltip: Keep a material index in memory instead of scanning the item registry for every drop. Disable only for troubleshooting.
instantunify.config.lazyIndexRefreshSeco: Rebuild the material index after this many seconds. 0 rebuilds it only when tags or the configuration change.
instantunify.command.reload: InstantUnify: configuration reloaded, %s player inventories updated.
instantunify.config.blacklistItems.toolt: Item ids that are never replaced, for example a charged crystal that should stay as it is. Empty by default.
instantunify.config.namespaceAliases.too: Namespaces that mean the same material. One line per group, names separated by commas; the first name of a group is the canonical one.
